description: Create a Suno task on RunAPI (text to sound). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for async notifications. Declared type: string.

grab_lyrics.description: Capture lyric subtitles. Default false. Declared type: boolean.

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

prompt.description: Sound description (max 500 characters). Declared type: string.

sound_key.description: Musical key. Declared type: string. Known values: "Cm", "C#m", "Dm", "D#m", "Em", "Fm", "F#m", "Gm", "G#m", "Am", "A#m", "Bm", "C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B".

sound_loop.description: When true, produce loopable audio. Default false. Declared type: boolean.

sound_tempo.description: Tempo in BPM (1-300). Declared type: integer.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: text_to_sound
